intents.title: Productive community capital institution
intents.statement: Transform PumpStation into an immigrant-led, agent-operated institution for evidence-bound research, productive ownership, business building, acquisition intelligence, and long-term community capability.
intents.source_location: Section 1 Product definition and Final objective
intents.intended_outcome: Replace dependence on manufactured price momentum with institutional-grade productive-asset research and capability.
intents.rationale: The user explicitly authorized implementation and repository migration.
unresolved_questions: Which initial productive-asset vertical should become the first closed pilot?

intents.title: Human and Kernel sovereignty
intents.statement: Models reason. Agents propose. Policies and authorized humans decide. The Kernel determines what may become real. Reality determines what was correct.
intents.intended_outcome: Prevent agents, models, local applications, and consensus from creating external-effect authority.
intents.rationale: This is the explicitly stated permanent UNIIMENTE rule.
unresolved_questions: What versioned interface will the canonical UNIIMENTE Kernel expose?

intents.title: Stage 0 simulation-only release
intents.statement: The first release is PumpStation Labs, simulation only, with no real money, offer, coordinated market action, public asset promotion, custody, orders, swaps, deposits, or performance claims from fixtures.
intents.intended_outcome: Make the first executable release incapable of financial external effects.
intents.rationale: The user made simulation-only behavior a hard release requirement.
intents.next_review_trigger: Any source or dependency introducing a financial action surface

intents.title: Anti-manipulation prohibitions
intents.statement: Encode pump-and-dump, coordinated price movement, wash trading, fake volume, spoofing, deception, guarantees, fabricated partnerships, fake accounts, concealed compensation, coordinated exits, suppressed dissent, affinity pressure, organizer custody, outside capital, and owned-asset promotion as hard prohibitions.
intents.intended_outcome: Make manipulation harder than productive contribution.
intents.rationale: These mechanisms conflict with participant protection and the new productive product definition.
intents.next_review_trigger: Every classifier escape or false-positive review
unresolved_questions: Which languages require reviewed manipulation patterns before Stage 1?

intents.title: Evidence-gated launch ladder
intents.statement: Implement Stages 0 through 5 as explicit evidence gates with hash-bound promotion packets and no agent approval.
intents.intended_outcome: Prevent subjective safety judgments and uncontrolled capability expansion.
intents.rationale: The user specified exact stage capabilities and evidence requirements.

intents.title: Ten proposal-only agent roles
intents.statement: Organize ten specialist roles that can collaborate and recommend but never approve, self-expand, or create authority.
intents.intended_outcome: Improve research breadth while keeping authority outside agent consensus.
intents.rationale: The roles were explicitly required and are bounded as contracts rather than an autonomous swarm.
conflicts: Simpler centralized analyst may be sufficient
intents.next_review_trigger: Held-out comparison against centralized and deterministic systems
unresolved_questions: Whether all ten roles add measurable value

intents.title: Typed community deliberation
intents.statement: Build attributable typed channels while preventing popularity, reactions, chat, or volume from becoming evidence or tool instructions.
intents.intended_outcome: Enable legible debate, preserved dissent, correction, complaint, and education.
intents.rationale: Typed channels separate claims, evidence, dissent, and authority.

intents.title: Machine-readable opportunity packet
intents.statement: Compile every opportunity into the specified evidence, economics, conflict, risk, benefit, exit, kill, simulation, and status fields.
intents.intended_outcome: Turn community opportunity claims into comparable, rejectable institutional objects.
intents.rationale: The packet is the smallest canonical object that can preserve evidence and downside.
intents.next_review_trigger: First schema change requested by a real reviewer

intents.title: Zero-trust capabilities
intents.statement: Every actor requires identity, class, explicit capability, expiry, purpose, resource ceiling, data scope, and revocation; future execution grants add exact strategy, allowlists, ceilings, approvals, evidence, and reconciliation.
intents.intended_outcome: Remove ambient authority and make every permission bounded and attributable.
intents.rationale: Identity without scoped authorization is insufficient for a consequence-bearing institution.
intents.next_review_trigger: Before any production authentication or grant issuer

intents.title: Selective blockchain use
intents.statement: Use blockchain only for minimum necessary identity, credentials, governance receipts, proof anchors, escrow, multisignature controls, ownership, attribution, settlement, and revocation; never as the primary database, private store, AI memory, event bus, sensitive-data store, or proof of legitimacy.
intents.intended_outcome: Capture selective verifiability without public-data leakage or architectural waste.
intents.rationale: Stage 0 has no named external verifier or settlement need, so no chain dependency is justified.
intents.next_review_trigger: A named verifier requires a public anchor or ownership record
unresolved_questions: Chain, privacy model, fees, revocation, and legal structure

intents.title: Affinity and community protection
intents.statement: Provide plain-language and multilingual disclosures, cooling off, visible compensation, conflicts, risk acknowledgment, independent complaints, whistleblowing, appeal, correction, withdrawal, non-retaliation, and no coercive recruitment or refusal penalty.
intents.intended_outcome: Use community trust for research collaboration without allowing it to replace diligence.
intents.rationale: Immigrant-led capital systems face material affinity-exploitation risk.
unresolved_questions: Languages, cooling-off duration, complaint independence, withdrawal rules

intents.title: Append-only institutional records
intents.statement: Record every material submission, evidence change, conflict, recommendation, dissent, simulation, decision, promotion, incident, correction, reconciliation, and retirement additively; never silently rewrite history.
intents.intended_outcome: Make institutional truth replayable, attributable, and resistant to narrative rewriting.
intents.rationale: Decisions and corrections require provenance to support accountability and learning.
unresolved_questions: Independent checkpoints, backup, concurrency, access control

intents.title: Truth-first operating metrics
intents.statement: Use the complete-evidence, preserved-dissent, reproducible-results, zero-prohibited-coordination rate as the first bottleneck metric and never optimize simulated returns above truth, risk, or participant protection.
intents.intended_outcome: Align system improvement with institutional integrity rather than superficial return.
intents.rationale: The user explicitly selected the initial Single Bottleneck Metric.
unresolved_questions: Pre-registered thresholds for false positives, false negatives, cost, and complaint resolution

intents.title: Four-system executable experiment
intents.statement: Compare coordinated multi-agent review, one centralized analyst, deterministic rules, and a passive benchmark on the same opportunities, preserving negative results and requiring material outperformance before complexity.
intents.intended_outcome: Make multi-agent complexity earn its cost.
intents.rationale: A simpler system should win unless evidence supports coordination overhead.
unresolved_questions: Real operating cost, time, calibration, and harm labels

intents.title: Autonomous treasury and sovereign intent
intents.statement: Historical artifacts describe a self-sustaining autonomous entity with sovereign intent, autonomous treasury, direct trading, self-modification, and self-preservation.
intents.intended_outcome: Preserve historical ambition without converting it into executable authority.
intents.rationale: The later explicit human-sovereign rule and current master prompt prohibit these mechanisms in PumpStation.
intents.next_review_trigger: Only a new explicit founder constitutional decision can revisit non-consequential metaphors; external authority remains Kernel-bound

intents.title: Outside capital only at regulated Stage 5
intents.statement: Do not implement outside-capital intake until qualified counsel, legal structure, regulatory classification, eligibility, offering documents, custody, valuation, administration, audit, conflicts, fiduciary accountability, reserves or insurance, and explicit founder decision exist.
intents.intended_outcome: Prevent an unlicensed fund, offering, brokerage, custody, or adviser function.
intents.rationale: Software tests cannot substitute for the named external legal and operational requirements.
conflicts: Any pre-Stage-5 investor deposit or pooled-capital proposal
intents.next_review_trigger: Stage 5 only after completion of Stages 0 through 4
unresolved_questions: Jurisdiction, asset classification, vehicle, custody, adviser, broker, offering, tax, fiduciary, and state-law requirements
